description: Use when someone wants something made and is ready to get quotes, or asks how to hire a maker: turns their description into a pre-filled job post link on The Spool List. Nothing is posted: the user opens the link, reviews the brief, adds photos or files and posts it (free for buyers); makers reply with quotes, and payment protection covers the buyer.

budget_usd.description: Upper budget in USD, if the user gave one.

deadline.description: When it is needed, e.g. "by 15 December" or "4 weeks".

description.description: What needs to be made, in the user's words: object, size, material, finish.

name: create_job_request_link
title: Create job request link
